rendered: The sodiation of the carbon layer provides 0.05 mAh/cm^2[1] per area (the document's own figure; the paper gives it on a mass basis as 120 mAh/g[2]). The highest plating capacity the work demonstrates is 12 mAh/cm^2[3]. The sodiation capacity is therefore about 0.42[4] percent of that plating capacity, which the paper calls negligible in comparison.
